ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across approx. 95% of the surface area; high-intensity (white) pixels localized in scars, abrasions, and lateral tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-grey to black pigmentation across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white circular geometric rings positioned medially on both lobes. High-intensity white clusters at both distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide-angled, shallow V-shaped depression dividing the lobes at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration with variable amplitude and frequency along the entire trailing edge boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep originating from the median notch transitioning to a convex curve towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially discrete circular white rings: two prominent on the left lobe, at least three visible on the right lobe. High-intensity textured clusters at the extreme lateral tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned white linear pixel disruptions: one diagonal mark on the lower left lobe, several intersecting linear marks on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized barnacle colonization at both lateral tips and multiple circular scars (rosettes) distributed across the ventral surface.
